WITH account_counts AS (
  SELECT district_id, COUNT(*) as account_count
  FROM account
  GROUP BY district_id
),
totals AS (
  SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT district_id) as num_districts,
    COUNT(*) as total_accounts
  FROM account
),
stats AS (
  SELECT 
    ac.district_id,
    ac.account_count,
    CAST(ac.account_count AS REAL) / t.total_accounts as share,
    CAST(ac.account_count AS REAL) / t.total_accounts - 1.0 / t.num_districts as diff_from_avg
  FROM account_counts ac
  CROSS JOIN totals t
)
SELECT 
  district_id,
  account_count,
  share,
  diff_from_avg
FROM stats
WHERE diff_from_avg >= (
  SELECT MIN(diff_from_avg) FROM (
    SELECT diff_from_avg FROM stats ORDER BY diff_from_avg DESC LIMIT 10
  )
)
ORDER BY diff_from_avg DESC
